title: Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven

entities.name: Strixhaven University
entities.description: Arcavios's premier institution of magical learning, founded over 700 years ago by five spellcasting dragons and divided into five colleges.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane of Strixhaven, whose magic is formed of five dichotomies of opposing mana colors and which has many Omenpath openings.

entities.name: Silverquill
entities.description: The college of language magic, expressed through spoken, written and signed word as ink and light.

entities.name: Prismari
entities.description: The college of elemental magic as art, embodying blue and red mana.

entities.name: Witherbloom
entities.description: The college that draws power from life and death.

entities.name: Lorehold
entities.description: The college of history and living history, driven by order and chaos.

entities.name: Quandrix
entities.description: The college of nature mathematicians who study fractals and patterns.

entities.name: Founder Dragons
entities.description: Five mighty elder dragons who founded Strixhaven and ended the Blood Age.

entities.name: Shadrix Silverquill
entities.description: A Founder Dragon who founded the Forum of Amity as a center for diplomacy.

entities.name: Dragonsguard
entities.description: An elite group of mages who work directly with the Founder Dragons to support their work.

entities.name: Path Ward
entities.description: A committee established to oversee, approve and vet travel through Omenpaths.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: Portals linking Arcavios to the wider Multiverse.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian attack that damaged or destroyed much of Strixhaven's campus and killed faculty.

entities.name: Biblioplex
entities.description: Strixhaven's library, rebuilt after the invasion.

entities.name: Ezroi
entities.description: A demi-plane that scholars theorize merged with Karudis to form Arcavios.

entities.name: Karudis
entities.description: A demi-plane that scholars theorize merged with Ezroi to form Arcavios.

entities.name: Dawning Age
entities.description: The earliest age of the plane, from which snarls, star arches and archaics originate; it ended when younger species brought war.

entities.name: Blood Age
entities.description: The era from about 7,000 to 700 years ago of violent wars that ended when the five dragons founded Strixhaven.

entities.name: Mystic Age
entities.description: The current era in which mages are the most powerful force.

entities.name: Forum of Amity
entities.description: A diplomatic center in northeast Arcavios founded by Shadrix Silverquill where conciliators negotiate and sometimes duel.

entities.name: Titan's Grave
entities.description: A vast forest growing in the remains of a giant titan, a Witherbloom research site.

entities.name: Lumarets
entities.description: Small mysterious magical creatures native to Titan's Grave.

entities.name: Spectacle Summit
entities.description: An elementally charged canyon in central Arcavios hosting Prismari's Summitfest.

entities.name: Paradox Gardens
entities.description: A Quandrix research site in the southeast with strange natural and temporal anomalies.

entities.name: Fields of Strife
entities.description: A site in the Tor-Kathorra desert where restless Blood Age spirits fight a perpetual battle.

entities.name: Archaics
entities.description: Giant wise beings tied to the oracles of Arcavios, many of which have become erratic and rampaging.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: A powerful mage seeking the cause of the archaics' erratic behavior.

entities.name: Professor Mavinda
entities.description: Strixhaven professor who signs the welcome message with the Welcoming Committee.

entities.name: Orrithia
entities.description: The northern continent of Arcavios, commonly called the Vastlands.

entities.name: Galathul
entities.description: The mysterious southern continent of Arcavios.

events.summary: Two demi-planes, Ezroi and Karudis, are theorized to have merged, knotting contrasting mana types into the five dichotomies.
events.quote: two demi-planes, Ezroi and Karudis, merged as a result of an unknown cosmic event.

events.summary: The Dawning Age ends as younger humanoid species rise and bring war.
events.quote: The Dawning Age ended when younger species of humanoid creatures rose to prominence and brought with them a time of war.

events.summary: The Blood Age ends when five elder dragons found Strixhaven University.
events.quote: It was only when five mighty elder dragons came together and founded Strixhaven University that the Blood Age finally came to an end

events.summary: Each Founder Dragon consolidates the study of two mana colors into a college, and mages become the most powerful force.
events.quote: Each dragon consolidated the study of its two mana colors into a magical college

events.summary: The Phyrexian Invasion damages Strixhaven and kills many faculty.
events.quote: During the Phyrexian Invasion, much of the university campus was damaged or destroyed, and a significant number of faculty lost their lives.

events.summary: Strixhaven welcomes its first off-plane students the year after the invasion.
events.quote: The inaugural class of off-plane students was welcomed at Strixhaven the year after the invasion

events.summary: Strixhaven establishes the Path Ward to oversee Omenpaths and vet visitors.
events.quote: the university has established the Path Ward, a committee to oversee the Omenpaths.

events.summary: Shadrix Silverquill founds the Forum of Amity to strengthen the peace formed at the end of the Blood Age.
events.quote: the Forum of Amity was founded by Shadrix Silverquill as a center for diplomacy.

events.summary: Archaics become erratic and rampage across the plane, and Jadzi seeks the cause.
events.quote: Currently, many of the normally gentle archaics have become erratic and incensed.
